Hi Sam / Lina —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Big appreciate the context on your backlog and the performance goals for realtime summarization in clinical workflows — that was really helpful.

Per our discussion, next best step is a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our ML + infra leads to:
- Walk through your sample workload and latency targets
- Share Redwood inference architecture and kernel/quantization options that impact throughput
- Map integration points (auth, KMS, audit logs) and data flow
- Agree on success criteria and a mutual action plan

Proposed attendees (from Redwood): Camila Reyes (AE), Marissa Cole (Solutions Architect), Dylan Brooks (Runtime PM). From Acme: your ML lead and infra/MLOps.

Proposed times (PT):
- Thu, Apr 22 — 10:00–11:30 (90 min)
- Fri, Apr 23 — 14:00–15:30 (90 min)
- If you prefer a 60 min slot we can do Thu 10:00–11:00 as well.

Draft agenda is attached (Tech_Deep_Dive_Agenda.pdf) and I included a short pre-meeting questionnaire (Pre-Meeting_Questions.docx) — can you ask the ML/infra folks to fill the questionnaire ahead of time if possible?

If you can confirm which time works and who from your side will join (names + emails) I'll send a calendar invite and include the deeper docs (redwood_solution_brief.pdf).

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,

1) 10m – Introductions & success criteria (Camila / Sam)
2) 25m – Workload walkthrough (Acme ML: Lina / Jorge) + sample request patterns and token budgets
3) 25m – Redwood runtime + quantization options that impact latency/throughput (Dylan)
4) 20m – Integration & security (KMS, audit logs, VPC) (Marissa)
5) 10m – Action items & next steps

Pre-reads that would be helpful: a sample request pattern (1–2 examples), current P95 latency from your service, and any constraints (on-prem, VPC, HIPAA). We'll attach the Redwood solution brief to the invite.

I'm happy to own the integration/security chunk. Camila — if you can send a calendar invite with the agenda and links to the docs I'll make sure Dylan has runtime slides ready.
